bug_semantics: Repo.init forwards caller **kwargs verbatim into git init with no unsafe-option denylist. git init --template=<dir> copies <dir>/hooks into the new repo, so an attacker-controlled template= path plants a hook that runs on the next git operation (arbitrary code execution). --separate-git-dir is a parallel unguarded redirect through the same sink.
flaw_origin: 33ebe7acec14b25c5f84f35a664803fcab2f7781 (root 'initial project') first wrote Repo.init_bare(path, **kwargs) as git.init(**kwargs) plus Git.transform_kwargs, documenting kwargs as extra git-init options. That unguarded forwarding is the mechanism; later init_bare->init rename (00c5497f), package moves, and 15ee0ac0's git.init(path,**kwargs)->git.init(**kwargs) fix are not first-writes.
ai_marker: absent; author/committer Michael Trier <mtrier@gmail.com>; root commit message is only 'initial project' with no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with/bot trailers
evidence: First-party GHSA-9rj7-rf2p-w77r (https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/security/advisories/GHSA-9rj7-rf2p-w77r) and GHSA-298h-jpq4-m665/CVE-2026-76218: Repo.init forwards **kwargs to git init; template installs hooks. NVD vulnStatus=Received, GHSA withdrawn_at=null. Vulnerable sink at 3.1.57 git/repo/base.py Repo.init: git.init(**kwargs) with no check_unsafe_options (clone already had unsafe_git_clone_options including --template). git log -S 'git.init(**kwargs)' -- '*.py' first hits 33ebe7acec14b25c5f84f35a664803fcab2f7781 lib/git_python/repo.py:267 git.init(**kwargs) in init_bare; git cat-file -p 33ebe7ac shows no parent (root). Git.transform_kwargs in the same commit maps template= to --template=. 00c5497f190172765cc7a53ff9d8852a26b91676 renamed init_bare->init (refactor; parent 806450db9b2c4a829558557ac90bd7596a0654e0 still had git.init('--bare', **kwargs)). 15ee0ac0d56a5fb5ba13fae4288621ddd2185f17 only dropped the erroneous path positional. git merge-base --is-ancestor 33ebe7ac 3.1.57 succeeds. Fix d9ddb55bdc66ffe8c9932fe460e6b8c8211e47c7 ('Guard unsafe git init options') adds unsafe_git_init_options=['--template','--separate-git-dir'] and check_unsafe_options before mkdir/git.init; parent 9b5dcaf85da5946dbf69dcd53f9edba08f760b32 still unguarded. d9dd is ancestor of tag 3.1.58 and not of 3.1.57. AI markers on the fix (Assisted-by: GPT 5.6; Co-authored-by: GPT 5.6 <codex@openai.com>) are not BIC attribution.
reasoning: The advisory is a real unpatched-until-3.1.58 RCE via unguarded git-init option forwarding, not withdrawn. The smallest public first-write of that mechanism is the 2008 root commit: init_bare already forwarded arbitrary kwargs into git init through transform_kwargs. Subsequent Repo.init naming, tree moves into git/repo/base.py, and the path-argument correction do not introduce the flaw. AI is judged only on 33ebe7ac: human author Michael Trier, no AI trailers, root commit. Therefore NOT_AI.
